review_kind: manual protected contract revision on unchanged upstream source; no automatic approval exception
patch_delta: Adds only the live-auto guard in Session::persist_execpolicy_amendment (core/src/session/mod.rs) and its regression test (core/src/session/step_activation_tests.rs). All other hunks are byte-identical to 128293eb.

resolves.execpolicy_amendment_after_switch: persist_execpolicy_amendment, the only writer of execpolicy amendments, now holds the active_turn lock that apply_turn_settings uses to publish doxaAuto, and refuses to write once the active turn has switched. A stale exec approval with AcceptWithExecpolicyAmendment answered after the switch is still denied by request_command_approval and no longer leaves a durable allow rule in memory or on disk. The exec-policy update semaphore is a leaf lock, so holding active_turn across it cannot deadlock.
resolves.context_management_token_budget: Host side, no patch change: DOXA passes features.context_management=false with the other protected overrides and refuses startup unless config/read reports it false. apply_experimental_context returns before enabling TokenBudget when ContextManagement is off. apply_model_defaults already honours the explicit features.token_budget override. The key exists, defaulting to false, in 0.163.0, 0.164.0 and 0.165.0.

compatibility: Retained contracts stay keyed by version, so the replaced 128293eb patch is not added to retained.json; it remains in the installer migration registry and as PREVIOUS_PATCHES for rollback. Docker sessions saved with the beta.76 provider are refused on resume with their data retained, and resume with beta.76.
regression_negative_control: With the guard disabled the regression fails at its unchanged-rules-file assertion: the approval is denied but the rule is written.
compiled_verification: Separate hash-bound build and compiled guard proof required; this static review record is never an acceptance receipt.
